nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of each holder in ERC20.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) tracking spending allowances.
Private uint256 holding the total supply of BEND tokens.
Private string holding the ERC20 token name, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string holding the ERC20 token symbol, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private uint8 holding the number of decimals, initialized to 18.
Constructor of the Token (BEND) contract that mints 100000 * 10**decimals() tokens to msg.sender.
Constructor of ERC20 that initializes _name, _symbol and _decimals.
Internal ERC20 function that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal ERC20 function that moves tokens between balances and calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards to _transfer using _msgSender() as the sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and updates the caller allowance.
Public ERC20 approve that forwards to _approve using _msgSender() as owner.
Internal ERC20 function that writes the _allowances mapping for owner/spender.
Internal ERC20 function that destroys tokens, reducing _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Empty virtual hook called before every transfer, mint and burn; overridable by derived contracts.
Public view function returning _balances[account].
Public view function returning _totalSupply.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable for meta-transaction support.
Public function increasing allowance of spender by addedValue for _msgSender().
Public function decreasing allowance of spender by subtractedValue for _msgSender().
The caller address, used as the mint recipient in the Token constructor and returned by _msgSender().
Arithmetic _totalSupply = _totalSupply.add(amount) inside _mint, protected by SafeMath overflow check.
Arithmetic _balances[account] = _balances[account].add(amount) inside _mint, protected by SafeMath.
Arithmetic _balances[sender] = _balances[sender].sub(amount) inside _transfer, protected by SafeMath.
Address parameter sender of the internal _transfer function.
Address parameter recipient of the internal _transfer function.
uint256 parameter amount of the internal _transfer function.
Address parameter account of the internal _mint function, receives minted tokens.
uint256 parameter amount of the internal _mint function.

edges.reason: Token constructor invokes the ERC20 base constructor with name 'BEND' and symbol 'BEND'.
ERC20 constructor assigns the name argument into the _name state variable.
ERC20 constructor assigns the symbol argument into the _symbol state variable.
ERC20 constructor initializes _decimals to 18.
Token constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
msg.sender controls who receives the entire initial supply minted in the constructor.
msg.sender is passed as the account argument of the internal _mint call.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, so caller identity controls allowance and transfer authorization.
The account parameter is the mint recipient inside _mint.
The amount parameter is the minted quantity inside _mint.
The minted amount is added to _balances[account] through SafeMath add.
_mint increments _totalSupply with a SafeMath add operation.
_mint credits the recipient balance with a SafeMath add operation.
_mint writes the _balances mapping for the recipient account.
_mint updates the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes complete, an external callback surface.
The sender parameter is used as the debit side of _transfer.
The recipient parameter is used as the credit side of _transfer.
The amount parameter drives the balance subtraction and addition in _transfer.
The transfer amount is subtracted from _balances[sender] via SafeMath sub.
_transfer performs the SafeMath sub on the sender balance.
_transfer updates the _balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are rewritten.
Public transfer delegates the token movement to the internal _transfer function.
transfer resolves the caller through _msgSender.
transferFrom delegates the token movement to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom reduces the caller allowance through the internal _approve function.
transferFrom resolves the spender through _msgSender.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the _allowances mapping of the sender.
Public approve delegates allowance assignment to the internal _approve function.
approve uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping entry for owner and spender.
_burn decrements _balances[account] with SafeMath sub.
_burn decrements _totalSupply with SafeMath sub.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are reduced.
increaseAllowance routes its allowance update through _approve.
increaseAllowance resolves the owner and spender through _msgSender.
decreaseAllowance routes its allowance update through _approve.
decreaseAllowance resolves the owner and spender through _msgSender.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping for the queried account.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only an input carrier for the _transfer core function and carries no standalone semantics.
The recipient parameter is only an input carrier for the _transfer core function and should be folded into it.
The amount parameter is only an input carrier for the _transfer core function and should be folded into it.
The account parameter is only an input carrier for the _mint core function and should be folded into it.
The amount parameter is only an input carrier for the _mint core function and should be folded into it.
